$doc: CorpFlowAI business CRM operating baseline — maps #701 operator stages onto existing leads + qualification_json. No second CRM. No schema change. No env. No live send.
$warning: NO SECOND CRM. NO SCHEMA. NO ENV. NO LIVE EMAIL/WHATSAPP/SMS. Persistence stays on Postgres leads + qualification_json.

purpose.operator_surface: /change where applicable; product desks /admin/lead-rescue and /admin/rapid-delivery until Prospect Operations views are unified
purpose.business_crm: CorpFlowAI own pipeline: market, qualify, quote, win/lose, hand off to delivery
not_this_pack: client tenant workflows (Lux concierge CRM, CIPC Desk, other tenant /change tickets)
a second production app or database
ERPNext as the daily prospect pipeline (ERPNext is invoicing/identity after commercial approval)

new.label: New
new.required_next_action: Review intake, assign owner, prepare acknowledgement draft within 24 hours

contacted.label: Contacted
entry_criteria: Acknowledgement prepared and operator-sent on an approved channel
exit_criteria: Qualification complete enough to book discovery, or disqualified
contacted.required_next_action: Complete qualification questions; set next action + due date

qualified.label: Qualified
entry_criteria: Discovery/demo booked or equivalent confirmation of fit
exit_criteria: Discovery complete and scope/price known, or not a fit
qualified.required_next_action: Hold discovery; capture notes; decide proposal vs not-fit

proposal_prepared.label: Proposal / quotation prepared
entry_criteria: Scope and price taken from the product pricing guide — not invented
exit_criteria: Proposal reviewed; copy-ready to send (operator sends manually)
proposal_prepared.required_next_action: Assemble quotation using product pack; do not send until operator review

awaiting_decision.label: Awaiting decision
entry_criteria: Proposal or payment instruction sent by the operator (not by automation)
exit_criteria: Won (payment confirmed — protected), lost, or nurture/stalled after cadence
awaiting_decision.required_next_action: Follow-up on cadence day 1/3/7/14; never invent a close date or value

won.label: Won
entry_criteria: Payment or equivalent commercial acceptance confirmed by operator
Payment confirmation is a protected action — not auto-marked
exit_criteria: Delivery issue opened; handoff to #550 (Lead Rescue) or #654 (Website Rescue)
won.required_next_action: Open delivery issue from the won-client template; do not keep selling in the pipeline row

lost.label: Lost
entry_criteria: Explicit decline, or follow-up cadence exhausted
exit_criteria: Reactivation signal within 90 days may return the row to new or contacted
lost.required_next_action: Record won/lost reason; stop chasing unless reactivation is due

nurture.label: Nurture / follow-up
entry_criteria: Timing is wrong but relationship is open
closure_reason or nurture_reason plus next_action_due (reactivation target)
exit_criteria: Reactivate to contacted/qualified, or close as lost/not_fit
nurture.required_next_action: Value-first check-in using draft assets only; no live send from the system

closed.label: Closed
entry_criteria: Terminal outcome recorded (lost, not a fit, or delivery complete with CMP ticket Closed)
exit_criteria: Only reopen on a genuine reactivation signal

next_action_and_due.gap: Rapid Delivery desk still lacks a first-class owner and next_action_due key — adopt the same JSON keys; do not add Prisma columns

owner.gap: Rapid Delivery owner missing — configuration/JSON adoption, not schema

consent_contact_preference.gap: Lead Rescue intake does not always persist consent_contact — record in notes until a later JSON key is adopted

paths: cmp_tickets.id when a delivery ticket exists

owner_next_action_rule.due_date_required_on: every active row after first review

ai_lead_rescue.label: AI Lead Rescue
qualifying_questions: What is the business name and who owns follow-up today?
Where do enquiries arrive (WhatsApp, web form, Instagram, phone)?
What happens after an enquiry arrives — and what gets missed?
Is the buyer the decision-maker for a USD 150 launch pilot?
What timing matters in the next 14 days?
disqualifiers: Wants a guaranteed revenue or lead-volume outcome
Needs a full CRM migration or multi-source rebuild in week one
Unwilling to name one leaky enquiry source
ai_lead_rescue.recommended_next_action: If gate passes: book 15-minute discovery, then proposal via #551 path. If not: mark not_fit with reason.

website_rescue.label: Website Rescue
qualifying_questions: What is the current website URL (or why is there none)?
What should a visitor be able to do in one tap (enquiry, call, WhatsApp)?
Is this a landing-page rescue or a larger rebuild?
Who approves copy and design, and how fast can they reply?
Is hosting/domain already owned by the client?
disqualifiers: Multi-site / shop / complex integration in the first engagement
Competitor research or free advice only
Expects SEO ranking or sales guarantees
website_rescue.recommended_next_action: If gate passes: discovery then quotation from the Website Rescue pack. If scope is a custom project, do not force the SKU — use a project quotation path.

managed_workflow.label: Managed workflow / administration improvement
qualifying_questions: Which named workflow is broken (intake, follow-up, quoting, delivery updates)?
Who does the work today, and where does it live (inbox, sheet, WhatsApp)?
What does 'done' look like in 30 days?
Is this a CorpFlowAI-operated outcome or a client-owned tool install?
Are there regulated or client-private data constraints?
disqualifiers: Request is a generic chatbot / generic AI agent with no owned workflow
Requires a new self-hosted tool that is not already authorised
Client wants CorpFlow to store another organisation's customer database as a second CRM
managed_workflow.recommended_next_action: Qualify as a managed outcome, not a tool sale. Do not open a new CRM platform. Escalate to Anton before promising a new product SKU.

future_product.label: Future product template
qualifying_questions: What buyer pain is named in one sentence?
What product or SKU is this closest to (Lead Rescue, Website Rescue, custom project)?
What evidence of fit exists today?
What must not be promised (revenue, rankings, volume)?
disqualifiers: Duplicates an existing SKU under a new name
Requires protected runtime (send, payment, schema) to even qualify
future_product.recommended_next_action: Capture on the existing lead row with product path = future. Do not create a new table or vendor. Review in weekly pipeline.

qualification_to_quotation.note: Manual quote → invoice → payment evidence. No payment runtime in this pack.

accepted_quotation_to_delivery.note: Lead Rescue delivery #550/#715; Website Rescue offer/delivery #654/#716. Open a delivery issue; do not reuse the prospect row as the project.

delivery_to_support.to: support / maintenance note on the delivery issue

new_enquiries.source: count of rows whose canonical_stage is new (or native NEW_INTAKE / new_intake)

qualified_opportunities.source: count of rows in discovery_booked or later active stages

quotations_issued.source: count of rows in proposal_ready or proposal_sent

wins.source: count of canonical_stage = won (only after operator-confirmed payment/acceptance)

losses.source: count of canonical_stage = lost or not_fit

value_by_stage.source: sum estimated_value only where a numeric value already exists on the row; omit the cell if unknown

source_product_conversion.source: counts grouped by intake_meta.product and intake_meta.source when present; never infer conversion % from empty data

configuration_only_opportunities: Use this stage map instead of inventing a parallel status enum
Adopt Rapid Delivery JSON keys owner, next_action, next_action_due to match Lead Rescue (no Prisma column)
Record consent_contact on intake_meta when the form already collects it
Store related quotation/delivery GitHub issue numbers in qualification_json related_refs
Keep draft-only follow-up copy in config/prospect-draft-assets.v1.json
code_without_schema: Wire /change/revenue to the same Postgres leads instead of browser localStorage (#721 / #772)
Shared Prospect Workbench UI over the existing view-model
Duplicate-email warning on operator desks (read-only compare; no merge automation)
schema_blockers: New CRM tables or a second database
New leads columns for owner, stage, due date, or consent (JSON is sufficient)
Paid CRM vendor or additional production app
explicit_non_actions: No automated external email, WhatsApp, or SMS
No client-private data in docs, tests, or screenshots
